title: Outer Banks Kayak Rentals Tandem Kayaks
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy the natural beauty of the Outer Banks with kayak rentals from Kitty Hawk Kites. Paddle through calm coastal waters and spot local wildlife with options for both single and tandem kayaks. Whether you're a solo adventurer or looking for a fun outing with family or friends, the flexible rental durations and convenient delivery or pickup options ensure a hassle-free experience. Perfect for all skill levels, these kayaks come with all necessary safety gear and quick instruction to get you started.

- Choose from single or tandem kayak. Or reach out to one of our team members @ 252-441-4124 about renting a Hobie pedal kayak for your adventure
- Flexible rental durations available, from hourly to weekly
- Convenient delivery or pickup options at multiple Outer Banks locations
- Suitable for ages 5+ with adult supervision
